name: Notesy
tagline: An easy to use notes app with a canvas
description: Notesy is a native macOS notes app designed for focus and speed. It features a HapticCanvasView for tactile input and a LiquidGlassBoxView for a modern, glass-like UI.
Built for the modern Mac, it integrates deeply with system technologies to ensure your notes are always available, fast, and secure.

features.title: Haptic Canvas
features.body: Experience a tactile note-taking feel with our proprietary HapticCanvasView.

features.title: Liquid Glass UI
features.body: A clean, modern interface that fits perfectly into the macOS aesthetic.
